description: Browse books by genre without free-text query. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

genre.description: Genre name or slug as on knigochit.ru (e.g. `фантастика`).

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

name: books_by_genre
